record.field: List the WhatsApp accounts (numbers) the user can use, with the messages still available today. Use it only when the user must choose between accounts.
Find WhatsApp conversations by contact name or phone number.
Read the latest messages of a WhatsApp conversation (what was sent and what the contact answered).

Prepare a WhatsApp message to a contact as a DRAFT. NOTHING is sent: a person must approve it in Odoo. Use 'Find Partner' first to get the contact id. Write the final text, polite and short, in the language of the contact.
List the WhatsApp drafts that are waiting for a person's approval.
